abstract:
BACKGROUND: Prognostic stratification after curative-intent resection for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains challenging. We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis to identify prognostic factors associated with overall survival (OS) in resected PDAC.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, Web of Science and the Cochrane Library were searched for studies reporting hazard ratios (HRs) for OS after PDAC resection. Observational studies and randomized trials reporting univariable or multivariable HRs for clinicopathologic and treatment variables were eligible, regardless of treatment sequence. Pooled HRs with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were estimated using fixed- or random-effects models according to heterogeneity, and multivariable estimates were synthesized when available.
RESULTS: Fifty-two studies (79,446 patients) were included. In univariable analyses, older age, male sex, elevated preoperative CA19-9 and CEA, higher NLR and CRP/Alb, pancreaticoduodenectomy (PD) vs. distal pancreatectomy (DP), vascular/perineural invasion, positive resection margin, poor differentiation, advanced T stage, and node-positive disease were associated with worse OS, whereas postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy was associated with improved OS. In pooled multivariable analyses, older age (HR 2.17), male sex (HR 1.62), PD vs. DP (HR 1.76), high CA19-9 (HR 1.63), elevated NLR (HR 1.62), increased CRP/Alb (HR 2.05), vascular invasion (HR 1.54), positive resection margin (HR 1.73), poor histologic grade (HR 1.63), advanced T stage (HR 1.74), and node-positive disease (HR 1.68) were associated with worse OS, while adjuvant chemotherapy was consistently associated with improved survival (HR 0.52). Preoperative CEA and perineural invasion did not retain statistical significance in pooled multivariable analyses.
CONCLUSIONS: In resected PDAC, prognosis appears to reflect not only anatomic stage but also pathological, biological, host-related, and treatment-related factors. These findings support a more integrated postoperative risk-stratification framework beyond anatomic staging alone, which may help identify high-risk patients and inform postoperative management.
key_points_ko: 총 52개 연구 및 79,446명의 수술 받은 췌관선암 환자 데이터를 메타분석했습니다.
수술 후 보조 항암치료는 사망 위험을 48% 감소시켜 생존율을 크게 개선했습니다(위험비[HR] 0.52).
고령(HR 2.17), 높은 CRP/Alb 비율(HR 2.05), 췌십이지장절제술(PD) 대 원위부 췌절제술(DP)(HR 1.76), 절제 단면 양성(HR 1.73), 림프절 전이(HR 1.68) 등이 사망 위험을 높이는 주요 다변량 예후 인자로 나타났습니다.
summary_ko: 근치적 절제술을 받은 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자 79,446명을 대상으로 한 52개 연구를 분석하여 전체 생존기간(OS)에 영향을 주는 예후 인자를 확인했습니다. 다변량 메타분석 결과, 고령, 남성, 높은 CA19-9 수치, 호중구 대 림프구 비율(NLR) 및 CRP 대 알부민 비율(CRP/Alb) 상승, 혈관 침윤, 절제 단면 양성, 분화도 불량, 진행된 T 병기, 림프절 전이가 불량한 생존율과 연관되었습니다. 반면 수술 후 보조 항암치료는 생존율을 크게 개선하는 것으로 확인되었습니다.
title: Prognostic factors for resectable pancreatic adenocarcinoma: a systematic review and meta-analysis
title_ko: 수술 가능한 췌장암의 예후 인자: 체계적 문헌 고찰 및 메타분석
